title: Withered City
description: A lonely, withered city block at night where nobody is left but the neon still burns. Crumbling concrete towers with broken floors, roads split by roots and dead trees, wet streets and magenta fog, blade signs down the facades (HOTEL, NOODLE with a dead O, a flickering OPEN), SYNTH CORP along a floor edge, a rooftop billboard that says SEE YOU TOMORROW, and on the plaza huge glowing block letters that still say STILL HERE. Walk in from the east road, open the jammed shutter of the tall ruin, ride the lift to its roof and look out over the signs. Built entirely from MCP tool calls.

steps.note: Ground: a flat terrain under the whole block. It only shows where roads and slabs are broken, in the empty lots and around the ruins, so its layers are moss, rubble, weeds and dirt, painted by hand.
Plaza: twenty cracked tile slabs with gaps between them. One corner slab has sunk into a puddle, another was heaved up by roots, and two lost a corner to the clip tool so weeds grow through.

The letters: one create_brush call with shape text lays STILL over HERE out as block letter brushes, readable from the south and from the tower roof. Glowing paint (withered/letters emits through its _emission map). The I has tipped, the last E lost a corner and the H sags where the slab below it gave way.
Roads: asphalt slabs split by crack cutters (thin rotated brushes subtracted with CSG) and shallow potholes that hold water.
The tall ruin south of the road, the lookout: six storeys as hollow boxes with windows, a lift shaft cut through every slab, a jammed shutter in the doorway and a bite out of the south west corner.
Break the tower: a rotated cutter bites the south west corner off the top floors, a blast hole opens the north facade, and the parapet in front of the view has crumbled.
Buttons on posts next to the shaft move the lift a moment after the press, time to step on. One on the ground floor, one on the roof.
The doorway: a rusted shutter that slides up, jammed until you press the button beside it.
The lookout roof: someone's chair and sofa face the letters, a stove barrel still smoulders. Reaching the roof shows a line on the HUD.

properties.text: The letters are still lit. Someone is still here.

steps.note: North west: the tallest ruin, ten storeys whose crown was clipped off at an angle and whose north east corner fell. A floor slab broke loose and leans against its east face.
One window of the high rise is still lit.
North east: a three storey brick block whose roof caved in. The roof slab lies tilted inside.
West of the plaza: four storeys of mossy plaster. The second floor burst open towards the plaza and its slab slid down onto the pavement.
East of the road: a row of shops under flats. Rusted shutters, one torn open, and a glowing PHARMACY sign that lost an A.
South west: a low warehouse with a corrugated roof, half of it gone.
Skyline: dead towers further out, their tops clipped at angles, only there to fill the fog.
Further out: more dead blocks along the roads, simple boxes with broken tops that only need to read through the fog.
Street lamps: rusted poles along the road, dead except for one that flickers.
Leftovers: covered cars, tyres and dead oaks that grew through the cracks.
Roots of the dead oak on the road heave the asphalt: bark cylinders laid across the crack.
Weeds and dead trees: sets painted only where the ground terrain itself is the first thing hit, so they grow through cracks, gaps and the empty lots but never through asphalt or slabs.

The neon street: the east end of the south road is now the way in, a straight run between rows of two to four storey ruins, brick and weathered wood with sagging roofs, broken balconies and gutted shopfronts. The player starts at its east end looking down it towards the hotel sign and the plaza.
Damage: roofs with holes, balconies hanging off their brackets, a fire stair that tore loose from the north row, rusted awnings.
Street signs: tall blades with round tops and logo discs, red letters in double cyan and red tubes, facing down the street, and box signs over the doors in red, orange, teal and yellow.
Paper lanterns blown down into the wet street, still glowing orange.
Litter: planks, tiles and paper on the road, cables snaking across it and sagging between the facades, a power pole that fell from the north sidewalk, and debris caught mid air in the storm.
Storm clouds: flattened, roughened blobs low over the far end of the street, dark against the sky and lit by the flashes.

The storm: rain over the whole street from one env_particles, and a random timer that throws a cold flash over the city, twice in quick succession. The bolt far down the street is the light's fixture, so it only shows while the flash is on.

Neon: the power never went out for the signs. Blade signs stand off the facades so they read down the streets, words run along floor edges, a billboard on the plaster block faces the lookout roof, and the far towers still carry theirs through the fog. Coloured lights beside the big signs throw magenta and cyan onto the wet roads. Some signs gave up: a dead O, a BAR hanging from one bracket and an OPEN that flickers on a random timer.
HOTEL: a two sided blade off the north east corner of the lookout, red letters in a cyan frame, facing up and down the road.
24H over the lookout doorway, small cyan letters on a dark plate.
SYNTH CORP along the floor slab between the fourth and fifth storey of the high rise, facing the plaza, with a cyan tube underlining it.
Billboard on the plaster block roof, turned to face the lookout: SEE YOU over TOMORROW, on rusted legs in a magenta frame.
NOODLE: a tall blade off the shops' north end, yellow in a magenta frame. Its second O burned out, a grey tube among the lit ones.

steps.note: A green cross beside PHARMACY, and BAR over the torn shutter, hanging askew from one bracket.
OPEN: a blade off the warehouse's north east corner. Its light flickers from a random timer, and the letters are the light's fixture, so they go dark with it.
LIVE FOREVER: an advert on steel legs over the roof of the dead block behind the plaza, the biggest sign in the view from the lookout roof.
Skyline: ARCADE across a dead block behind the plaza, CASINO down the tall tower beyond it, blue white tubes up the brick block's corners.
